text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Signs and symptoms of acute or chronic overdosage may be those of individual INFUVITE ADULT component toxicity. In post-marketed surveillance, overdosage with INFUVITE ADULT at two times the prescribed dose did not result in toxicity.
